params.prompt:
Create a polished 5-second square social media ad video from this exact ad creative. Preserve the original image composition, brand colors, logo, UI cards, and ALL existing text exactly as shown. Text must stay perfectly readable for the full video. Do not rewrite, replace, morph, add, or hallucinate any letters, words, numbers, symbols, buttons, logos, UI, hands, tools, vehicles, or people. Keep the headline and CTA locked in place with no distortion.

Motion: subtle premium ad motion only — gentle camera push-in, slight parallax between roofer/background/UI cards, soft light sweep, tiny floating motion on UI cards. Keep all text panels stable and sharp. No cuts. No audio. Clean commercial look, not cinematic chaos.
